label: Truthmaker coverage, uniformity and necessity
resolution: Coverage quantifies over true represented facts and local makers; it does not bind the same maker across worlds. MakerNecessitation constrains truth conditional on bearer existence, not necessary bearer existence. Restricted per-individual labels are narrower than the ordinary phrase mere-existence truths. Absolute emptiness quantifies over every eligible maker; concrete-only emptiness leaves existing abstract makers. The all-world scope and rigid truthbearer availability of formal profiles are analyst assumptions, not attributed from Merricks’s prose.
